symptom: Orders database write queries timing out with DB-1205 error
root_cause: Long-running report transaction held row locks on order_items table
fix: Killed blocking session 4821 and enabled query timeout on reporting queries

symptom: orders-db lock wait timeout during flash sale burst
root_cause: Concurrent updates to inventory rows created deadlock cycle
fix: Updated update sequence to sort inventory keys before acquisition

symptom: Checkout service reported DB-1205 lock wait exceeded on orders-db
root_cause: Unindexed foreign key check caused full table scan lock
fix: Added index on customer_id foreign key column

symptom: Payment confirmation updates hung waiting for row lock in orders-db
root_cause: Stale connection from payment gateway failed to commit transaction
fix: Terminated orphaned connection and lowered idle transaction timeout

symptom: Nightly reconciliation job blocked real-time orders on orders-db
root_cause: Reconciliation job ran in READ COMMITTED with exclusive table locks
fix: Modified job to run in READ UNCOMMITTED snapshot mode

symptom: msg-queue reported MQ-2041 consumer lag over 50000 messages
root_cause: Downstream order consumer workers crashed due to unhandled null payload
fix: Patched deserializer with null check and restarted consumer pod replicas

symptom: Notification events delayed by 45 minutes on msg-queue
root_cause: Slow third-party SMS provider API caused consumer thread starvation
fix: Enabled asynchronous SMS dispatch and doubled consumer worker count

symptom: Partition 3 on orders topic stalled with MQ-2041 lag alert
root_cause: Poison pill message caused repeated consumer crash loops
fix: Skipped offset and forwarded bad message to dead-letter queue

symptom: msg-queue consumer lag spike after marketing campaign email blast
root_cause: Consumer group under-provisioned for 10x traffic spike
fix: Scaled consumer deployment from 4 to 16 replicas

symptom: Billing queue consumer lag triggered MQ-2041 high severity alert
root_cause: Database connection pool exhausted in billing consumer process
fix: Increased database pool max_connections and restarted consumers

symptom: feed-gateway throwing HTTP 503 and FEED-7002 thread pool saturated
root_cause: Sudden burst of unthrottled requests exhausted Tomcat worker threads
fix: Enabled client rate limiting and doubled thread pool capacity

symptom: feed-gateway CPU hit 99% with elevated request latency
root_cause: Catastrophic backtracking in regex validation filter
fix: Replaced greedy regex with deterministic string prefix matcher

symptom: feed-gateway health checks failing during morning traffic ramp
root_cause: Downstream pricing service degradation caused thread pool queuing
fix: Configured circuit breaker with 2s fallback timeout on pricing client

symptom: FEED-7002 thread exhaustion reported on feed-gateway pod cluster
root_cause: Keep-alive idle connection leak from legacy HTTP/1.0 clients
fix: Reduced idle keep-alive timeout to 15 seconds

symptom: High CPU utilization and dropped packets on feed-gateway edge
root_cause: TLS handshake renegotiation loop under heavy connection churn
fix: Disabled TLS renegotiation and enabled TLS session caching

symptom: calc-engine aborted nightly settlement batch with JOB-5003 error
root_cause: Null currency code in merchant record caused NullPointerException
fix: Quarantined record 99201 and re-executed batch pipeline

symptom: JOB-5003 calculation batch failure on batch 104 in calc-engine
root_cause: Out of memory error during matrix multiplication on batch data
fix: Increased JVM heap limit to 8GB and partitioned calculation into two sub-jobs

symptom: Scheduled risk aggregation job failed at step 4 in calc-engine
root_cause: Upstream data feed file was missing required checksum file
fix: Regenerated checksum file and retriggered aggregation job

symptom: calc-engine terminated batch calculation due to socket read timeout
root_cause: Network partition between calc-engine worker and input storage node
fix: Configured retry policy with exponential backoff on data loader client

symptom: Hourly index calculation failed with JOB-5003 code
root_cause: Schema mismatch in date format between feed-gateway and calc-engine
fix: Added ISO-8601 date parser fallback to calculation ingestion module

symptom: Interservice API calls failed with SSL certificate expired error
root_cause: Internal ingress TLS certificate expired before renewal job executed
fix: Generated new TLS cert, updated Kubernetes secret, and restarted ingress

symptom: orders-db pod evicted with disk full alert
root_cause: Slow query log grew unchecked filling host root volume
fix: Purged old logs, enabled logrotate with 3-day retention, and freed 45GB

symptom: Application instances crashed with ENOSPC write error
root_cause: Unrotated application logs filled container ephemeral storage
fix: Cleaned up /tmp crash dumps and enforced log size capping

symptom: TLS handshake failure between feed-gateway and payment gateway
root_cause: Intermediate certificate bundle omitted during previous rotation
fix: Re-uploaded full certificate chain bundle to secret store

symptom: calc-engine worker node disk utilization exceeded 95%
root_cause: Failed batch scratch files not cleaned up after job termination
fix: Ran scratch cleanup script and added post-exit cleanup hook
